# Run pipeline and save pipeline logs (ideal final run)
- Re-runs all pipeline
- Prints log with all warnings
```{r}
targets::tar_destroy(ask = FALSE)
targets::tar_make(
  callr_arguments = list(
    stdout = "pipeline_log.txt",
    stderr = "pipeline_log.txt"
  )
)
```

# TEST Biomass component integrity

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr) # if you plan to uncomment the filter

df_diff <- tar_read(validation_biomass_sums) %>%
    mutate(SimName = str_extract(SimulationName, "^.*?(2024|2025)")) %>%
    filter(DiffAbs != 0)

# 1. Find the absolute maximum value across both columns so the axes match perfectly
max_val <- max(c(df_diff$Wheat.AboveGround.Wt, df_diff$Comp_Sum), na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Build the ggplot
p <- df_diff %>% 
  #filter(str_detect(SimulationName, "Big")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Wheat.AboveGround.Wt, y = Comp_Sum, colour = SimulationName)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  # Force both axes to start at 0 and end at the exact same max value
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val)) +
  # Force a square aspect ratio in standard ggplot
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# 3. Convert to interactive graph and enforce the 1:1 ratio in Plotly
ggplotly(p) %>% 
  layout(
    # scaleanchor ties the y-axis scale to the x-axis scale
    yaxis = list(scaleanchor = "x", scaleratio = 1),
    xaxis = list(constrain = "domain")
  )
```

```{r}
require(dplyr)
require(targets)

# 1. Load the master list of all expected SimulationNames
master_df <- tar_read(df_simNameByCult)
expected_sims <- unique(master_df$SimulationName)

# 2. Load the interpolated data you want to check
pcds_int <- tar_read(df_PCDS_int)
pcds_int <- tar_read(df_list_PCDS)

# 3. Extract the surviving SimulationNames safely
if (is.data.frame(pcds_int)) {
  surviving_sims <- unique(pcds_int$SimulationName)
} else if (is.list(pcds_int)) {
  # If it's a list of dataframes, bind them first
  surviving_sims <- unique(dplyr::bind_rows(pcds_int)$SimulationName)
} else {
  stop("df_PCDS_int is an unexpected format.")
}

# 4. Find the ones that got dropped (In Expected, but NOT in Surviving)
dropped_sims <- setdiff(expected_sims, surviving_sims)

# 5. Print the autopsy report
message("==========================================================")
message("   DROPPED SIMULATIONS REPORT")
message("==========================================================")
message("Total Expected:  ", length(expected_sims))
message("Total Surviving: ", length(surviving_sims))

if (length(dropped_sims) == 0) {
  message("\n✅ PERFECT: No simulations were dropped!")
} else {
  message("\n❌ ALERT: ", length(dropped_sims), " simulations are missing:")
  print(dropped_sims)
}
message("==========================================================")
```

```{r}
require(dplyr)
require(targets)

target_sim <- "DookieWWHI2024CvMowhawkSow17-Apr"
pcds_list <- tar_read(df_list_PCDS)

# Flatten and filter for Mowhawk
mowhawk_timeline <- dplyr::bind_rows(pcds_list, .id = "df_name") %>%
  dplyr::filter(SimulationName == target_sim) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Date)

# Print the findings
message("Total PCDS observations found for Mowhawk: ", nrow(mowhawk_timeline))
print(mowhawk_timeline)
```
